review.why: Plans, audits and fixes paid ads on Google, Meta and LinkedIn with platform playbooks and strict rules about missing data.
review.summary: Gathers goals, offer, audience and current state, then routes by intent to reference playbooks: payback math, B2B paid, Meta decisions, LinkedIn, Google Search, ABM, RSA output, audits. It covers structure, budgets, retargeting, landing-page alignment, brand versus non-brand and a weekly check ending in HOLD, FIX, TEST or INVESTIGATE, with unavailable inputs labeled MISSING.
strengths: Unknown is not failing: only verified items are scored
No fixed kill rules: a CPA spike is a question, not a verdict
Drafts changes to live accounts first and applies them only with approval
cautions: Most thresholds live in seventeen reference files not read here
Some retargeting and scaling claims rest on one practitioner's frameworks without sources
Assumes an agent connected to ad accounts for the live-account parts
